## Activity

During May 2024, Market Eye Clinic recorded 456 captures. Activity was monitored against the expected operation of the service, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available records indicate that capture activity continued across the reporting period without other operational issues being identified.

## Image quality

Of the 456 captures, 90 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 19.7. The level of ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine review, with attention to image capture and patient positioning processes where appropriate. This will support consistent image quality and help identify opportunities for improvement in future sessions.

## Grading

A total of 81 captures were recorded as referable following grading. The median lag from capture to grading was 3. This indicates that graded results were generally processed within a short interval. Continued monitoring of the grading queue and turnaround remains appropriate to support timely review and onward action for referable findings. Overall, the activity and grading information provides a summary of service delivery at Market Eye Clinic for May 2024.
